questions.solution:
player = "rock"
computer = "scissors"
if player == computer:
    result = "draw"
elif (player == "rock" and computer == "scissors") or \
     (player == "scissors" and computer == "paper") or \
     (player == "paper" and computer == "rock"):
    result = "win"
else:
    result = "lose"
print(result)

questions.description: 判断三边能否构成三角形。

统计及格与不及格人数。
questions.code_template:
scores = [55, 72, 88, 45, 90]
passed = 0
for s in scores:
    if s >= 60:
        passed += 1
failed = len(scores) - passed
print(___)
questions.solution:
scores = [55, 72, 88, 45, 90]
passed = 0
for s in scores:
    if s >= 60:
        passed += 1
failed = len(scores) - passed
print(f"Passed: {passed}, Failed: {failed}")
